name: Queue one official new spy in the preserved failed game with proven capacity

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_SPY_RETRY')); assert(r.current==2 and r.mode=='PRODUCE' and r.archive.eventID==0 and not Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY'),'new spy requires archived failed mission and an empty retry reference'); ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Queue('SPAWN_SPY'); return 'official civic prerequisite check queued'

condition.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; if b.lastAction=='ERROR_SPAWN_SPY' then error(b.lastAction) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_PREPARED')~=nil

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; b.SpyPrerequisitesReady(); b.Queue('BUILD_SPY'); return 'official native BUILD requested once'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_BUILD_SPY' or a=='REJECTED_BUILD_SPY' then error(a) end; return a=='READY_BUILD_SPY'
local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PROGRESS_SPY' then error(a) end; return Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_PROGRESS')~=nil

steps.code: local p=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_SPY_PRODUCTION')); assert(p.progressed and p.beforeCount==0,'production receipt differs'); return 'PRODUCTION_QUEUED'
